report.incidentSummary: On 2026-09-16 starting at 20:05:07 IST (14:35:07 UTC), users experienced severe latency (20-30 seconds) and intermittent failed answers when interacting with the assistant chat during the evening peak. Investigation revealed that the external upstream model provider (llm-provider) began returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests ('quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500') for model lumen-large-2026-08. Assistant-orchestrator's retry backoff policy (retrying up to 3 times with 2-8s delays) drove p95 LLM latency from ~5.5s to 21-23s, and conversations where all 3 retries were exhausted returned fallback messages, increasing overall orchestrator error rate from ~0.5% to ~4.5%. An evening prompt template release (CHG-48222) was ruled out because the degradation began 7 minutes prior to deployment and ran on orchestrator version 0.42.0 with stable token consumption.
report.rootCauseStatement: The external upstream dependency llm-provider enforced request-per-minute rate limiting (HTTP 429: 'quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500') on model lumen-large-2026-08 starting at 14:35:07 UTC. Assistant-orchestrator responded by backing off and retrying up to 3 times per request, compounding request latency up to 20-30 seconds and returning fallback failure responses on approximately 4.5% of requests when retry attempts were exhausted.

hypotheses.cause: External llm-provider enforced request-per-minute rate limits (quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500) starting at 14:35:07 UTC, causing assistant-orchestrator to back off and retry up to 3 times, driving end-to-end response latency to 20-30s and returning fallbacks when retries were exhausted.
hypotheses.rationale: Exact error messages in orchestrator logs show HTTP 429 'quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500' starting at 14:35:07 UTC. Metric rate_limited_count and retry_count jumped concurrently, pushing p95 latency to 21-23s and error rate to ~4.5% due to exhausted retries.

hypotheses.cause: The prompt template deployment (CHG-48222) to assistant-orchestrator caused processing delays and token bloat with llm-provider.
hypotheses.rationale: CHG-48222 was completed at 14:42:00 UTC, roughly 7 minutes after the 429 rate-limiting and latency surge began at 14:35:07 UTC. Orchestrator logs during onset confirm requests were running version 0.42.0 (pre-deployment), and llm_tokens_per_min remained flat without prompt-induced token inflation.

facts.statement: Starting at 2026-09-16T14:35:07.794Z (20:05:07 IST), assistant-orchestrator began receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses from llm-provider for model lumen-large-2026-08 with the message 'quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500'.
Zero WARN or ERROR records were logged by assistant-orchestrator between 14:30:00 UTC and 14:35:07 UTC.
assistant-orchestrator rate_limited_count surged from ~0/min prior to 14:35 UTC to 18.2/min at 14:36 UTC and sustained between 20 and 72.5/min through 15:00 UTC.
assistant-orchestrator retry_count jumped from baseline (1-3/min) to 19.9/min at 14:35 UTC, sustaining 38-52/min thereafter.
assistant-orchestrator llm_latency_p95_ms jumped from ~5.5s prior to 14:35 UTC to 10.65s at 14:35 UTC, and sustained 20.8s to 23.2s from 14:40 UTC through 16:10 UTC.
assistant-orchestrator error_rate rose from baseline (~0.5%) to 1.79% at 14:35 UTC and plateaued between 4.43% and 4.63% through 16:15 UTC.

All sampled ERROR logs in assistant-orchestrator between 14:35 and 15:00 UTC corresponded to conversations failing after 3 attempts with 'llm-provider 429 after 3 attempts; returned fallback message'.
assistant-orchestrator llm_tokens_per_min remained flat between ~284k and ~338k tokens/min throughout the window.
Prompt template change CHG-48222 (v0.42.0 to v0.43.0) completed deployment at 14:42:00 UTC (20:12:00 IST), while rate-limiting errors at onset were logged on version 0.42.0.
Downstream internal services compliance-filter, knowledge-index, and user-context-service maintained normal latencies (p95 ~122ms, ~93ms, ~196ms respectively) and recorded zero ERROR or FATAL logs.

inferences.statement: The user-reported 20-30s response time was caused by assistant-orchestrator's retry backoffs (retrying up to 3 times with delays of 2 to 8s) when encountering upstream HTTP 429s from llm-provider.
Approximately 4.5% of total assistant requests failed completely and received fallback answers due to exhausting all 3 retry attempts, while over 95% eventually succeeded despite severe latency.
CHG-48222 was not the root cause because the incident onset occurred 7 minutes before the change was deployed, the running version during onset was 0.42.0, and token consumption did not increase.

assumptions.statement: Total assistant request volume breached the 1500 RPM account quota with llm-provider due to peak evening user engagement, or the provider adjusted the tier limits upstream without notification.

timeline.event: Assistant orchestrator operates normally with p95 latency ~5.5s, error rate ~0.5%, and zero 429 rate limit events.
Incident onset: First HTTP 429 Too Many Requests ('quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500') received by assistant-orchestrator (v0.42.0) from llm-provider.
Metric rate_limited_count climbs to 18.2/min; retry_count climbs to 19.9/min; llm_latency_p95_ms spikes to 10.65s.
First hard conversation failure logged after 3 exhausted retries against llm-provider; fallback message returned to client.
assistant-orchestrator error_rate reaches 4.43% and llm_latency_p95_ms surges to 20.98s.
CHG-48222 deployed to assistant-orchestrator (v0.42.0 -> v0.43.0), 7 minutes after rate limiting began.
llm_latency_p95_ms reaches peak of 23.16s amidst sustained rate limiting of 40-70 count/min.

confidence.rationale: High confidence based on definitive orchestrator log messages directly quoting HTTP 429 'quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500' starting at 14:35:07 UTC, accompanied by exact alignment in rate_limited_count, retry_count, p95 latency (21-23s), and exhausted retry error rates. Internal dependencies were verified healthy, and the prompt deployment was ruled out chronologically.

gaps.description: Assistant orchestrator total inbound request rate metrics and upstream rate-limit response headers (e.g. x-ratelimit-remaining) were not directly captured.
gaps.impact: Minimal; while unable to confirm whether the 1500 RPM limit was breached due to app traffic growth or provider quota downgrade, the fact that rate limiting occurred is incontrovertibly proven.

recommendedActions.action: Request an immediate quota increase for requests-per-minute (RPM) on model lumen-large-2026-08 from llm-provider to accommodate evening peak traffic exceeding 1500 RPM.
recommendedActions.rationale: The upstream limit of 1500 RPM is being breached during evening traffic peaks, generating 40-70 throttled requests per minute.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor rate_limited_count on assistant-orchestrator to ensure it drops to 0 during peak traffic hours.

recommendedActions.action: Implement multi-model or multi-provider fallback / load-balancing in assistant-orchestrator when receiving HTTP 429 status codes.
recommendedActions.rationale: Currently, assistant-orchestrator relies solely on backoff retries against the same overloaded provider endpoint, delaying user responses by up to 20-30s before failing.
recommendedActions.verification: Simulate 429 responses in a staging environment and verify that calls fail over to secondary models or providers within sub-second latencies.

recommendedActions.action: Add proactive alerting on assistant-orchestrator rate_limited_count > 5/min and request quota utilization metrics.
recommendedActions.rationale: Enables engineering and support to detect and react to upstream rate limiting before users report pervasive 20-30s delays.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify alert firing in test environment when rate_limited_count metric exceeds threshold.
